title: Aligned thrusters stay on their line

text.guided: Look at u and v: one is a multiple of the other, so they point along the same line. Every combination stays on that line, and this target is not on it. When the thrusters are aligned and the target is off the line, press UNREACHABLE.
text.fast: v is a multiple of u: the span is a line, and the target is off it.

scene.caption: Both arrows lie on the same line
Whatever a and b you choose, you stay on that line
